meta.description: APP-CONFIG-018 (leaving-denver#225): daily email of the moving sale metrics. Prod only; the sale ends 2026-11-09 (README: Removing the sale).

parameters.body: SELECT blob1 AS event, blob2 AS source, blob3 AS item, blob4 AS bundle, SUM(_sample_interval) AS n FROM leaving_denver_sale_events WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '1' DAY GROUP BY event, source, item, bundle ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 500 FORMAT JSON

SELECT blob1 AS event, blob2 AS source, blob3 AS item, blob4 AS bundle, SUM(_sample_interval) AS n FROM leaving_denver_sale_events GROUP BY event, source, item, bundle ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 500 FORMAT JSON
